## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

OpenCode V2 setup is now available as an opt-in path for Action runs, while V1 remains the default. Provider API keys are kept in permission-restricted files and referenced from configuration, keeping them out of the restored session database; setup also installs and checks the required plugins, gates permissions and credentials, and waits for V1 history import to finish before prompting or saving. V2 execution itself is not yet supported, so runs selecting it stop after setup. [#2012](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2012)

Bundled Systematic skills can now read their own references and run their scripts under the Action’s external-directory restrictions. Access is limited to the installed version’s `skills/` directory, with edits still denied; other external paths remain restricted. [#2015](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2015)


<details><summary>Full changelog</summary>

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

An operator’s “Always” approval now applies only for the rest of the current gateway run, so a later run on the same repository must request approval again. The gateway keeps accepted permission patterns in run-local memory and answers matching requests from the run’s root or owned child sessions without reopening the approval UI; partial matches still require operator approval.

The grant is cleared when the run ends, and sibling requests covered by a new grant are settled through the approval registry so competing replies do not both reach OpenCode. The gateway sends “once” upstream rather than saving a persistent permission, and configured denials continue to take precedence. [#2004](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2004)


<details><summary>Full changelog</summary>

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

OpenCode V2 pin updates from Renovate now regenerate their SHA-256 digests automatically, preventing builds from failing because the version changed while the old digests remained. The pin’s Renovate rule runs the sync script before rebuilding the Action bundle, so the embedded pin is refreshed in the same update.

This removes the previous manual regeneration step; the configured commands also match the Renovate action’s allowed-command rules. [#1998](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/1998)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

OpenCode V2 workspace agents could start successfully but fail their first model request with a 401 because fresh per-spawn databases skip the migration that imports provider credentials. Each spawn now provisions credentials from the protected workspace secret and checks that the configured model's provider has a usable credential before readiness; missing credentials keep the spawn unready. The gateway proxy also limits forwarding to the exact routes its client needs, preventing access to upstream credential-management endpoints, and the workspace smoke test now verifies an actual model request and the no-credential failure path. [#1993](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/1993)

Release jobs were spending several minutes rerunning install, lint, and build checks when semantic-release pushed its release commit and tag, even though CI had already run them. The release job now skips installing git hooks, avoiding those redundant pre-push checks while leaving the release-notes narration watch intact. [#1991](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/1991)
